meta.description: Identify differentially accessible chromatin regions across conditions using DiffBind, csaw, DESeq2, or edgeR; covers consensus-peak vs sliding-window choice, normalization, SVA/RUVseq batch handling and effect-size thresholds.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; planted K562-only peaks recovered as opened at 0.976-1.000 across modes

practice_boundaries.detail: Research-only analysis with no clinical claims

methodological_ground.detail: Surrogate variables verified to enter the DESeq2 design and change results; documented design restriction verified; residual mode inconsistencies are P2

code_usability.detail: All shipped CLI modes ran on real ENCODE data (rc 0) and guards rejected bad input with rc 1; the prior SVA and zero-hit failures are fixed and reproduced fixed

functional_suitability.note: DESeq2 and edgeR DiffBind backends, covariate design and SVA shipped; csaw, RUVseq and spike-in are labelled recipe-only; non-human TxDb untested

reliability.note: Previous crashes fixed (SVA, zero hits, CLI args); guards for labels, flags and design; SVA mode silently ignores --method and skips the blacklist filter

performance_context.note: SKILL.md 57 lines with routed references and a single script

agent_usability.note: Clear workflow and CLI header; SVA-mode limits documented only in the script header, and method-reference says SVA runs inside DiffBind

human_usability.note: Actionable error messages, effective normalization logged; PCA labels overlap for identical K562 replicates

security.note: Plain file inputs and cwd outputs; --txdb value is loaded with library() by name (local package name only)

maintainability.note: Versions stated and satisfied, license and provenance preserved; threshold semantics differ between default and SVA paths without a note

agent_specific.note: Precise description; body now matches the shipped script, except heatmap listed as output and SVA limits under-documented

key_strengths: The P0 SVA path is fixed: surrogate variables enter the DESeq2 design and the output equals an independent svaseq+DESeq2 fit exactly
Every advertised CLI mode (DESeq2, edgeR, covariate design, SVA, native/lib normalization, thresholds) runs on real ENCODE data and recovers the planted K562-only peaks
Failure guards are useful: unknown flags, wrong condition labels, invalid DiffBind design terms, zero-hit results and oversized SV requests
Docs now separate shipped code from recipe-only methods and state the DiffBind design restriction, which was verified true

recommendations.title: SVA mode skips blacklist filter with no warning
recommendations.problem: --sva fits DESeq2 on dba.count output and never runs the DiffBind blacklist step that the default path applies in dba.analyze; on this chr1 slice 0 of 2260 intervals were affected, but genome-wide input could report blacklisted regions.
recommendations.root_cause: fit_sva bypasses dba.analyze, which is where DiffBind applies blacklist and greylist filtering.
recommendations.fix: Call dba.blacklist with the genome-matched blacklist before the SVA fit, or emit a runtime warning and list the limit in SKILL.md.

recommendations.title: SVA-mode limits documented only in the script header
recommendations.problem: method-reference says --sva runs inside DiffBind although it is a direct DESeq2 fit; --method is ignored silently with --sva; SKILL.md lists a heatmap output that SVA mode does not produce.
recommendations.root_cause: Behavior notes live in the R header comment, not in SKILL.md or the reference.
recommendations.fix: State in SKILL.md and method-reference that --sva fits DESeq2 directly, ignores --method and --design, and omits the heatmap and blacklist step; warn at runtime when --method is passed with --sva.

recommendations.title: Effect-size threshold semantics differ between modes
recommendations.problem: Default and edgeR paths pass fold to DiffBind, which uses it as a DESeq2 lfcThreshold test (338 sites with FDR<0.05 and |Fold|>=1 are excluded, minimum reported |Fold| 1.22), while --sva applies a hard |LFC|>=1 post-filter (minimum 1.01); both are logged as |log2FC| >= 1.
recommendations.root_cause: DiffBind dba.report(fold=) is a thresholded significance test, not a post-hoc filter, and the docs describe both paths as the same cutoff.
recommendations.fix: Document the semantics difference or use a post-hoc |Fold| filter in both paths so counts are comparable across modes.

recommendations.title: Non-human TxDb untested; no SVA low-n caution
recommendations.problem: --txdb=<package> was executed only for none because no non-human TxDb was installed; the 4-sample SVA yields 1 SV correlated 0.53 with Condition and no caution says it may absorb real signal.
recommendations.root_cause: Only hg38 annotation packages were installed in the audit environment; no guidance on SVA validity for 2 vs 2 designs.
recommendations.fix: Add a short SKILL.md caution about SVA on very small designs and validate one non-model-organism TxDb when available.
